title: Photoelectric Effect from SDT Pressure-Node Binding
equations: SDT: W = binding energy of outermost electron pressure node
pipeline: 1. Verify linear E_k vs frequency relation
2. Verify correct threshold frequencies for metals
conclusion: 5/5 thresholds within 1%. Slope h = 4.136 eV/PHz (exp 4.136, err 0.00803%). SDT pressure-wave ejection reproduces photoelectric effect.
